hook: Mexico just caught an FBI top-10 fugitive
reel_hook: FBI's top-10 fugitive caught in Mexico

slides.title: Mexico nabs El Chapo Isidro
slides.image_prompt: Open steel handcuffs on a dark wooden table beside a folded Mexican flag, harsh spotlight from above, red and blue light reflections on the metal
slides.label: WORLD
points: Mexico detained alleged cartel boss Fausto Isidro Meza Flores.
He's on the FBI's Ten Most Wanted Fugitives list.
Violence broke out in Sinaloa after the arrest; check travel advice before going.
slides.body: Mexico detained alleged cartel boss Fausto Isidro Meza Flores. He's on the FBI's Ten Most Wanted Fugitives list. Violence broke out in Sinaloa after the arrest; check travel advice before going.

slides.title: Denmark expels Russian attaché
slides.image_prompt: Danish and Russian flags on separate poles drifting apart in cold wind, grey Copenhagen sky, a closed wooden embassy-style door below
slides.label: WORLD
points: It cites an alleged plot to kill Ukrainian rapper Kyivstoner.
Nothing changes day to day; watch whether Moscow expels Danish diplomats in return.
slides.body: Denmark expelled Russia's defence attaché. It cites an alleged plot to kill Ukrainian rapper Kyivstoner. Nothing changes day to day; watch whether Moscow expels Danish diplomats in return.

slides.title: Russian ship hit in Baltic
slides.image_prompt: Cargo ship on cold grey sea with dark smoke rising from its deck, small drone silhouette in the overcast sky above
slides.label: WORLD
points: A drone attack set a Russian cargo ship on fire.
Finland says it happened in the Gulf of Finland.
Details are thin: who did it and crew status remain unconfirmed.
slides.body: A drone attack set a Russian cargo ship on fire. Finland says it happened in the Gulf of Finland. Details are thin: who did it and crew status remain unconfirmed.

slides.title: Trump warns Iran over plot
slides.image_prompt: Two chess kings facing each other on a board under dramatic side light, long shadows, empty squares between them, dark background
slides.label: POLITICS
points: Trump threatened force over a reported Iranian 'dirty bomb' plot.
Nothing changes yet; treat viral claims about the plot with caution.
slides.body: Trump threatened force over a reported Iranian 'dirty bomb' plot. The plot itself remains unconfirmed. Nothing changes yet; treat viral claims about the plot with caution.

slides.title: Climate talks go to overtime
slides.image_prompt: Wall clock past midnight above an empty conference table with scattered papers, water glasses and a small globe, Mediterranean night beyond the window
slides.label: SCIENCE
points: COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye, ran past its scheduled end.
Countries still disagree on the final climate deal.
No deal yet; the final text decides how hard countries push on climate.
slides.body: COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye, ran past its scheduled end. Countries still disagree on the final climate deal. No deal yet; the final text decides how hard countries push on climate.

caption:
🚨 Mexico detained alleged cartel boss "El Chapo Isidro", on the FBI's Ten Most Wanted list. Violence followed in Sinaloa, so check travel advice.
🇩🇰 Denmark expelled Russia's defence attaché over an alleged plot to kill Ukrainian rapper Kyivstoner.
🚢 A drone attack set a Russian cargo ship on fire in the Gulf of Finland. Details still thin.
⚠️ Trump threatened force over a reported Iranian "dirty bomb" plot. The plot is unconfirmed.
🌍 COP31 climate talks in Antalya ran into overtime with no final deal yet.

Which story surprised you most?
